Vs

full_judgment: 24. In view of presumption arising out of registration of sale deed conveying title in the suit land, the learned Joint District Judge also fell in serious error in thinking that the plaintiffs have got an arguable case. The reasoning and findings of the learned Joint District Judge in support of his order are therefore, wholly based on misconception of the scope of equity in the hearing of the application for temporary injunction and non-application of mind in the facts of the case. Impugned order of status quo therefore cannot be sustained in law.
